issues.t: VC-Turbo engine bearing failure (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking or rattling from the engine, rough running, a check engine light or warning messages. In the worst case the engine fails while driving, and hot oil can leak and create a fire risk.
issues.why: Some bearings inside the variable-compression turbo engine may have manufacturing flaws and wear out over time. NHTSA campaign 25V-437 covers 2019-2022 QX50s along with Nissan models using this engine family.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If you hear knocking, stop driving and have the car towed. The dealer inspects the oil pan for metal debris, changes the oil and updates software, and replaces the engine for free if damage is found. Owners report long waits for parts, so book early.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
issues.sym: The car brakes hard or flashes a red collision warning and beeps with nothing ahead, sometimes on the highway.
issues.why: The forward radar and camera can falsely detect an obstacle. Infiniti issued bulletin ITB24-010 for false emergency braking and collision warnings on QX50s built through August 2022.
issues.next: Ask an Infiniti dealer to apply the bulletin and recalibrate the sensors. Keep the front sensor area clean, and report repeat events to NHTSA.

issues.t: Passenger airbag light from failed seat sensor
issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on or flashes, or the passenger airbag status shows off even with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: The occupant sensor built into the front passenger seat cushion fails with age. Dealers usually replace the whole seat cushion, which makes it a big repair.
issues.next: Have the airbag codes read; the passenger airbag may not work while the light is on. Ask about any recall or goodwill help, and get opinions from both a dealer and an independent shop.

issues.t: Dashboard gets sticky, melts or cracks
issues.sym: The top of the dashboard turns soft, sticky or shiny, cracks, or throws a bright glare onto the windshield that makes it hard to see. Some owners notice a chemical smell.
issues.why: The dashboard material breaks down after years of heat and sunlight. Owners of 2008-2011 EX35s report the same problem seen on G35/G37 models of this era.
issues.next: Ask an Infiniti dealer about goodwill coverage. A fitted dash cover cuts the glare. Replacing the dashboard is a big job.

issues.t: Engine loses power or shuts off while driving
issues.sym: The engine stumbles, loses power or shuts off while driving, sometimes with a check engine light, and may not restart right away.
issues.why: Owners report several causes, including ignition coil faults, sensor faults and, in rare cases, internal engine damage. There is no single recall for it.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Get to a safe spot and have the codes read as soon as possible. Repeated stalling is a safety risk, so don't keep driving the car until it is diagnosed.

issues.t: Transmission speed sensor fault and poor acceleration
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, the car won't pick up speed or shifts oddly, and in some cases it lurches or revs on its own.
issues.why: Owners report a failed transmission output speed sensor on these years. Some cars went on to need major transmission repairs.
issues.next: Have the codes read soon. A bad speed sensor is a simple fix compared with a transmission, so don't ignore the warning.

issues.t: Steering wheel locks up
issues.sym: The steering wheel locks or won't unlock. Owners report it happening when starting the car and, in rare cases, while moving.
issues.why: The electronic steering column lock used on Infinitis of this era can fail. This is the most-reported problem for the 2010 EX35.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. If the wheel won't unlock, don't force it; have the car towed. Ask the dealer whether an extended warranty or campaign covers the steering lock for your VIN.

issues.t: Steering shaft can develop play or separate (recall)
issues.sym: Looseness or extra play in the steering wheel. In the worst case steering control could be lost.
issues.why: On 2008 EX35s with the power tilt and telescoping steering column, the steering shaft can wear and separate (NHTSA campaign 15V-054).
issues.next: If the steering feels loose, stop driving the car. Check your VIN; dealers replace the steering shaft for free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light may show off with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: A part in the occupant classification control unit can make the system wrongly turn off the passenger airbag (NHTSA campaign 08V-521).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer tests the system and replaces the seat cushion sensor if needed, for free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not work after a dead battery (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign. The issue appears after the 12-volt battery has run very low.
issues.why: Software in the airbag control unit could keep the passenger airbag from working after a deep battery discharge (NHTSA campaign 08V-066).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer will reprogram the airbag control unit for free.

issues.t: Power steering groans and gets heavy
issues.sym: A groan or growl when turning, especially at low speed or when centering the wheel, and steering that feels heavier than normal.
issues.why: The hydraulic power steering pump or rack wears. RepairPal lists a groaning steering rack on all-wheel-drive EX35s, and a 2013 EX37 owner reports a partly seized pump.
issues.next: Check the power steering fluid level and look for leaks. Have the pump and rack inspected before the steering gets stiff.
issues.sevReason: Pump groan and gradual heaviness; first step covers sudden heaviness.

issues.t: Brake rotors warp and pulse early
issues.sym: The steering wheel shakes or the brake pedal pulses when stopping, most noticeably from highway speed. Rotors may need replacing sooner than expected.
issues.why: The front brake rotors wear unevenly or warp. RepairPal lists brake pulsation as the most-reported EX35 problem, and 2015 QX50 owners report early rotor wear.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected. New pads with quality rotors usually fix it. Avoid holding the brakes hard at a stop after heavy braking.

issues.t: Cracked radiator leaks coolant
issues.sym: Coolant puddles under the front, a sweet smell, a low coolant reservoir or the temperature gauge rising.
issues.why: The plastic radiator tank can crack with age and heat, often around 60,000-70,000 miles according to owners.
issues.next: Don't drive it if it is overheating. Have the cooling system pressure-tested and the radiator replaced.

issues.t: Doors won't unlock or open in cold weather
issues.sym: In cold weather (below roughly 30-40°F) the doors won't unlock or open from inside or outside. Some owners say they were stuck in the car.
issues.why: The door lock actuators wear out and struggle in the cold.
issues.next: Have the failing actuators replaced. Until then, know which doors still work so you can always get out.

issues.t: Engine idles low or stalls at a stop
issues.sym: The idle speed drops lower than normal, the engine hesitates, or it shuts off while idling.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB-11-018 covers idle hesitation and stalling at idle on these cars.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer to check the bulletin. A throttle body cleaning and idle relearn are common steps.

issues.t: Fuel pump buzzing from the back seat area
issues.sym: A buzzing or humming sound from the rear of the cabin, near the fuel tank.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB09-013 says certain fuel blends can make the fuel pump buzz. It does not affect how the car runs.
issues.next: Trying a different fuel brand may help. Have it checked only if the car also runs poorly.

issues.t: No-start or false warning lights from water in a wiring harness
issues.sym: The car won't start, or warning lights come on with nothing actually wrong.
issues.why: Water can get into a wiring harness. Infiniti ran service campaign P1223 for this (ITB11-034); that campaign is no longer active.
issues.next: Have a shop look for corroded or wet connectors and repair them.

issues.t: Harsh downshifts or hesitation when slowing
issues.sym: Firm downshifts or a hesitation while coasting or coming to a stop.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB12-064A covers this shift behavior.
issues.next: Ask the dealer whether the bulletin's transmission software update applies.

issues.t: Weak acceleration or slow braking from damaged brake wiring
issues.sym: The car feels slow to accelerate, or the brakes seem slow to respond.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletins ITB14-055 and NTB14-107 say damaged brake light switch wiring can cause these symptoms. Resting a foot on the brake pedal can also trigger them.
issues.next: Make sure your foot isn't resting on the brake. Have the brake light switch and its wiring checked.

issues.t: Check engine light from EVAP leak codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes P0442, P0455 or P0456. The car drives normally.
issues.why: The fuel vapor (EVAP) system has a small leak, often at the gas cap, a hose or a valve. Infiniti bulletin ITB13-044 covers the diagnosis for 2012 and newer models.
issues.next: Tighten or replace the gas cap first. If the light returns, have a smoke test done to find the leak.

issues.t: Sunroof glass shatters
issues.sym: The sunroof glass suddenly breaks while driving, sometimes with a loud bang and no sign of anything hitting it.
issues.why: Owners of 2013 EX37s and 2014 QX50s report the sunroof glass shattering on its own.
issues.next: Pull over safely and cover the opening. Ask about warranty or goodwill help; comprehensive insurance often covers glass.

issues.t: Backup camera stops working
issues.sym: The screen shows no rear camera picture when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Owners report the rear camera failing, often around 50,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the camera and its wiring checked.

issues.t: Key not recognized at start
issues.sym: The car won't recognize the Intelligent Key or start, sometimes with code B2190 stored.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB13002A lists causes including something else in the key slot, a key fault, wiring between the key slot and body computer, or the key slot itself.
issues.next: Try the spare key and a new fob battery first. If that fails, have the dealer follow the bulletin.

issues.t: Roaring cooling fan and weak A/C
issues.sym: A loud roaring noise from the engine cooling fan, and the A/C doesn't cool well.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB22-025 covers this fan noise and A/C cooling complaint.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletin. Don't ignore it if the temperature gauge starts rising.

issues.t: Infotainment freezes or audio won't turn on
issues.sym: The screens freeze or the audio system won't turn on, often after a phone call ends. Apple CarPlay may also act up.
issues.why: Infiniti issued several infotainment software updates for these years (ITB18-041 and ITB23-010).
issues.next: Ask the dealer to install the latest infotainment software.

issues.t: Moonroof rattles, pops or creaks
issues.sym: Rattling, popping, cracking or squeaking from the moonroof, especially over bumps.
issues.why: Infiniti issued bulletins for moonroof rattle and noise, and in some cases replaces the moonroof assembly.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletins while the car is under warranty.

issues.t: Rear differential judder or noise on AWD models
issues.sym: A shudder, vibration or noise from the rear of the car, often when turning or pulling away.
issues.why: Infiniti bulletin ITB12-072G covers judder and noise from the rear differential on AWD models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletin. Keep the differential fluid serviced.

issues.t: Underbody shield comes loose
issues.sym: Scraping or flapping from under the car. The plastic underbody shield can tear loose and hit a tire or wheel well.
issues.why: Owners report the underbody shield detaching while driving, sometimes after service.
issues.next: Pull over if you hear scraping. Have the shield refastened or replaced and check the fasteners after any service visit.

issues.t: Passenger knee airbag cover may break off in the cold (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign.
issues.why: In a crash in cold weather, the trim cover over the passenger knee airbag may come off instead of splitting open (NHTSA campaign 18V-593).
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers replace the knee airbag module for free.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be switched off (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture may not appear when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: The camera settings let the image be turned off, and that setting stays (NHTSA campaign 19V-654).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer updates the camera software for free.

issues.t: Steering knuckle or rear axle housing may be weak (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning before failure. In the worst case a wheel could come loose or steering could be lost.
issues.why: Some front steering knuckles or rear axle housings were not heat-treated correctly and may be too weak (NHTSA campaign 21V-402).
issues.next: Check your VIN right away. Dealers inspect and replace the parts for free.

issues.t: Passenger door may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: The front passenger door may not lock with the rest of the doors.
issues.why: The wrong door latch may have been installed (NHTSA campaign 23V-187).
issues.next: Check your VIN. A dealer replaces the door lock assembly for free.

issues.t: Tire sidewall may be cut from the factory (service campaign)
issues.sym: A cut on the outside wall of a tire, which can lead to a blowout.
issues.why: A manufacturing problem left cuts in the sidewall of some tires on 848 QX50s and QX55s. Infiniti campaign PC911 inspects and replaces them.
issues.next: Look over your tires and ask the dealer whether campaign PC911 applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not deploy properly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator may absorb moisture and not deploy correctly in a crash (NHTSA campaign 24V-154).
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers replace the driver airbag for free.

issues.t: Panoramic roof glass shatters while driving
issues.sym: The panoramic roof glass suddenly breaks while driving, with no impact.
issues.why: Owners report the glass shattering on its own. Glass may not be covered by the warranty without a recall.
issues.next: Pull over safely and cover the opening. File a report with NHTSA and check with your insurer about glass coverage.
